snippet.title: Kebab Chefs! - Restaurant Simulator 1.0 | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
After 2 years of early access, Kebab Chefs! - Restaurant Simulator reaching the full version on June 11!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1001270

Thank you everyone for supporting us during this journey. Kebab Chefs has came a long way and finally it's time to enjoy what've been cooking so far!
